digest_policy: The model repository publishes a 40-hex git oid, not a SHA-256. Both digests above were computed locally from the downloaded files and are pinned in the adapter; probe fails closed if either file drifts.
interface: speechbrain.inference.enhancement.SpectralMaskEnhancement.from_hparams with FetchConfig(allow_network=False) against a staged local directory, then enhance_batch
execution: 16 kHz CPU; one fresh model and one enhance_batch call per sample; MetricGAN+ spectral mask only, no SepFormer or SEGAN pooling; input length must be preserved exactly
runtime: Python 3.12.14, speechbrain 1.1.1, torch 2.14.0+cu130, device cpu, network disabled
